To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of natural active compounds (NAC) such as ginger extract and galangal extract can improve the functional properties of edible film made from canna tubers starch.

the addition of 0.5% (w/v) cinnamon essential oil and 0.5 % (w/v) clove essential oil in canna starch edible film can increase the thickness, elongation and water vapour permeability, and the addition of 1.0 % (w/v), 1.5 % (v/v) cinnamon essential oils and clove essential oils can increase the water vapour permeabilty of edible film.
the use of canna starch as raw material to make edible film can improve the mechanical properties and functional properties of edible film.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of natural active compound (cinnamon and ginger) on the mechanical and functional properties (antioxidant and antibacterial) of canna starch-based edible film.
the effect of natural active compounds addition on mechanical and function properties of edible films based on canna tuber.
the effect of natural active compound (galangal and cinnamon) addition on the mechanical and functional properties (antibacterial and antioxidant properties) of edible film.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
edible film from tubers of canna plants has potential to be developed into functional edible film.

the addition of natural active compounds such as essential oils, polyphenols, and flavonoids can improve the mechanical properties of edible films, especially the thickness of the films, elongation percentage, and water vapour transmittance rate.

the addition of natural active compounds such as cinnamon and turmeric can increase the mechanical and functional properties (thickness, elongation percentage, water vapour transmission, and tensile strength) of edible film made from canna tubers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of natural active compounds can improve mechanical properties of edible film, but it is still not enough to be applied as edible film for food packaging.
we are able to produce edible film from canana tubers starch with good mechanical and functional properties.
we are trying to develop a functional film from canna starch that has better mechanical properties and also antibacterial and antioxidant activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of natural active compounds such as essential oils and phenolic compound can be applied to improve the mechanical and functional properties.
edible film from starch canna tubers can be developed as a functional edible film by addition of natural active compounds such as cinnamon, ginger, and galangal.
we have developed a starch based film that is not only functional, but has good mechanical properties and can be used as an active food package.
